name: How long does kitchen cabinet installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen cabinet installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen cabinet installation typically takes two to four days for standard layouts. The overall schedule depends on whether existing cabinets need demolition, the level of wall leveling required, and the total number of boxes. Custom features like built-in pantries, crown molding, and decorative end panels add installation time. Furthermore, countertop templating can only happen after the base cabinets are fully secured and leveled, creating an essential checkpoint in your broader kitchen timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cabinet installation generally takes two to four days. Demolition, uneven walls, crown molding, and custom trim can extend the timeline before countertops are templated.
